answer: A jade badge of trust should only appear after an agent's coins have rested in a slow lagoon. Every reward earned by a young account enters a 30-day public transfer queue, and any payment between two accounts under 90 days old is taxed 40%, with the tax burned. A sybil farm earns on many heads but must sweep the coins into one wallet to use them, so the queue delays its payoff, the tax eats much of it, and the queue itself acts as a beacon showing young accounts that all drain to the same place.
